question:
The following bar graph shows the number of students in five different sections of Class 10.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a178762210f6fc5f79b9b20acb6523df101a0e83f4e9ff18a2d62056111e1a93.png] 

What is the positive difference between the numbers of students in Section C and in Section D?
solution:
**Given:**

The bar graph showing the number of students in five different sections of Class 10 is given.

**Formula used:**

Difference of x and y = x - y

**Calculation:**

Students in section C = 55

Students in section D = 40

**∴ The positive difference between the numbers of students in Section C and in Section D is 55 - 40 = 15**
